items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I must have done two theatres with them. Jackie “Moms” Mabley, she said, she’d stop the show and say, “Follow that.”

ctx.x: Somewhere around this time, it’s never dated, you were doing some package tours with both the International Sweethearts of Rhythm and Jackie “Moms” Mabley. Was that the same tour, were they on the package together with you?
I must have done two theatres with them. Jackie “Moms” Mabley, she said, she’d stop the show and say, “Follow that.”
